description: The distribution tables the JavaScript lowering (src/core/distributions.js) built before its deletion (WG-5683): the canonical text of the pinned tables, the unitExponential table, and the lowering of every distribution family of the queueing fixtures and of the reference families of docs/simulation.md (or the error it refused one with). The families the specifications lower are in tests/fixtures/lowering/inputs.json and the goldens. tests/core/lower.test.js#tables unchanged compares the Lean lowering with these, byte for byte as JSON text.
